components.name: AppShell
components.summary: The full StreamKeepr screen: top app bar, library drawer on the left, and the player column with the recording details and stats panel stacked beneath the play…

components.name: Buttons
components.summary: Material 3 buttons, icon buttons and filter chips used across StreamKeepr.

components.name: LibraryDrawer
components.summary: The left pane listing recordings grouped by streamer, newest first at every level.

components.name: RecordingDetails
components.summary: A collapsible card above the stats panel with the recording's title, streamer, category, size and the actions for it.

components.name: StatsPanel
components.summary: A collapsible "Stats for nerds" panel below the recording details, showing playback (video) and network statistics side by side.

components.name: StatusChip
components.summary: Small uppercase chips that state a recording's condition in words, with colour as a second cue.

components.name: TopAppBar
components.summary: The 64px bar across the top: menu (drawer) toggle, the StreamKeepr wordmark, recording search, disk space, schedule, settings and the Twitch auth control.

components.name: TwitchAuthButton
components.summary: The control that connects a Twitch account, enabling features that need it (following list, live notifications, auto-record of followed channels, subscriber-on…

components.name: VideoPlayer
components.summary: The primary component: a 16:9 HLS player with an overlay title strip and a control bar.
